greeting: Hello! I am your FreshFind Botanical Guide. I can help you locate open markets, discover in-season produce, check stall schedules, or plan your weekend basket. What are you looking for today?
suggestedPrompts: What can you help me with?
When is Green Valley Market open?
What is in season right now?
How do I open a Produce Guide?

intents.response: Fresh heirloom and beefsteak tomatoes are available right now at Green Valley Farmers Market, Skyline Organic Fair, and Golden Gate Eco-Bazaar! They are at peak ripeness.
Green Valley Farmers Market operates on Wednesday (08:00 - 14:00), Saturday (07:30 - 15:00), and Sunday (08:30 - 14:30) at 142 Grand Orchard Promenade in Downtown.

On Saturdays, multiple vibrant markets are open: Green Valley Farmers Market, Bayside Organic Pavilion, Old Town Meadow Guild, Pacific Grove Collective, Oakwood Community Yard, Timberline Hill, and Golden Gate Eco-Bazaar.

On Sundays, you can visit Green Valley Farmers Market, Highland Eco-Square, Sunburst Artisan Market, Old Town Meadow Guild, Valley Forge Botanical Market, Pinecrest Sustainable Agora, and Timberline Hill.
You can find freshly clipped organic Genovese basil, rosemary, culinary thyme, and mint leaves at Valley Forge Botanical Market, Highland Eco-Square, and Green Valley Farmers Market.
Our dynamic seasonal calendar tracks peak harvests! Autumn spotlights Gala apples, rainbow carrots, wild forest mushrooms, kabocha squash, and crisp Romanesco broccoli.
Use the 'Use My Location' button on our Find a Market bar to calculate real-time driving/walking proximity to all 14 regional farmers markets using browser GPS!
Our live system constantly reads your current device time and checks against every market's weekly timetable to highlight whether a market is OPEN NOW, OPEN SOON, or CLOSED.
You can heart any market or produce item to save it into 'My Fresh Finds'. You can also attach private session notes and export your customized market itinerary as a formatted download file!
Every vendor listed on FreshFind undergoes community verification: zero synthetic pesticides, water conservation audits, non-GMO heirloom seed preference, and transparent carbon footprints.
Need assistance or interested in listing your community market? You can reach the FreshFind team at hello@freshfind.green or visit our dedicated contact hub.

I can answer questions about market hours, Saturday or Sunday openings, nearby markets, seasonal produce, herbs, sustainability, Fresh Finds bookmarks, and the Produce Guide. Ask a specific question and I’ll point you to the right section.

keywords: how do i open a produce guide
intents.response: Open any produce card to launch its full Produce Guide. You’ll see the market price range, storage guidance, nutrition notes, local impact, regional markets, and a simple production guide explaining cultivation, harvest, and market handling.
Use the heart button on markets and produce to build your My Fresh Finds basket. You can add private notes and export the finished itinerary from the basket page.
FreshFind’s grower route is designed for farms, orchards, apiaries, and small-batch market stalls that want to be discoverable by local shoppers.
FreshFind is a lightweight community discovery platform focused on local markets, seasonal produce, regenerative growers, and privacy-first client-side features.
